content.title: Liverpool vs PSG - as it happened
content.text: Liverpool vs PSG, 2025/26 Champions League, quarter-finals, 14/04/2026, starting lineups. BeSoccer Join us for LIVE coverage of the 2025/26 Champions League quarter-finals fixture between Liverpool and Paris Saint-Germain, kick-off at 21.00 CET, at Anfield in Merseyside, England. List of goalscorers Match report in news FT (0-2): PSG claimed a 0-2 win on Tuesday at Anfield through Ousmane Dembele's decisive double, sealing a 4-0 aggregate triumph to reach the Champions League semi-finals. Thank you for joining us and see you soon! Goaaaaaal! de PSG en el 91' Statistics of O. Dembélé in Champions League 0.4 GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAALLL FOR PSG! Dembele fires home past Mamardashvili to grab his second of the night, finishing clinically to extend PSG's lead. Kerkez lets fly, but once more Safonov is equal to it, perfectly positioned to keep it out. Konate goes into the referee's notebook in the 85th minute after a late challenge. PSG sub: A change for Paris Saint-Germain sees Lucas Beraldo introduced into the action, with Zaire-Emery making way as they look to see things out. Gravenberch gathers Ngumoha's pass in stride and strides forward with intent, but his effort from around 25 yards lacks accuracy, sailing well off target. The energy has completely drained from the ground since that goal, the noise replaced by a stunned hush. What was once electric now feels lifeless, the home crowd deflated as the game slips away. Dembele bursts into the box, but can't quite get his shot away under pressure. The ball ricochets awkwardly off Mamardashvili and nearly spins into his own net, only to creep just wide of the post! GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAALLLL FOR PSG! Barcola carries the attack upfield with purpose and tees it up neatly for Dembele just outside the box. He keeps his composure and picks out the bottom corner with precision, sending the PSG bench into raptures! Substitution at Liverpool Liverpool sub: A fresh change for Liverpool as Ngumoha is brought into the action, with Joe Gomez making way. Chaos in the box as the ball drops kindly and Mac Allister sneaks in unnoticed on the blindside of Willian Pacho. There's a clip on his foot which sends him sprawling, and the referee points straight to the spot, with VAR now taking a closer look at the decision. Dembele squares it across for Barcola, who can't make the most of the chance, but it wouldn't have counted anyway as the flag goes up against the Frenchman. Salah shifts inside with purpose and picks out Kerkez bursting forward on an aggressive run. The chance opens up from a narrow angle, but the finish is swept across the face of goal and drifts wide of the far post. Gravenberch finds a pocket of space on the edge of the area and wastes no time in pulling the trigger, driving a low effort from around 20 yards. It flashes just beyond the post, a whisker away from troubling the goalkeeper. Paris Saint-Germain sub: Doue tries to carry on but quickly pulls up again, clearly struggling and in visible discomfort before hobbling off the pitch. That signals the end of his night, with Barcola brought on to take his place. Doue drives down the touchline with intent, only for Szoboszlai to step across and win the ball cleanly. There's a follow-through nudge, though, and Doue is sent off balance, crashing into a pitchside microphone by the boards and staying down after the collision. Substitution at Liverpool Substitution at Liverpool Liverpool double sub: A double switch for Liverpool sees Joe Gomez and Cody Gakpo introduced as Frimpong and Isak make way, signalling a tactical reshuffle as they look to shift the momentum. The second period starts at Anfield. HT (0-0): Liverpool and PSG had traded chances in a tense, goalless first half, with Isak, Dembele and Van Dijk all denied in key moments, while Marquinhos produced a remarkable last-ditch intervention. The visitors had applied relentless pressure as an injury to Mendes disrupted PSG, with Safonov standing firm. We'll see what happens next! Mac Allister goes into the referee's book after diving into a rash tackle, catching Joao Neves instead of the ball. The French are swarming all over them, pressing relentlessly and forcing mistakes, while Liverpool can barely string a pass together, repeatedly giving possession straight back. Szoboszlai shows immense determination to track back at full speed as PSG look to spring forward, engaging Doue in a physical duel and doing just enough to disrupt the move, snuffing out the danger before it can develop. Paris Saint-Germain sub: Nuno Mendes pulls up and is unable to continue, limping off to be replaced. Lucas Hernandez is introduced as they're compelled into a change at the back. Kvaratskhelia glides in from the flank with that trademark swagger, shifting onto his stronger foot before firing goalwards, only to see his effort deflected behind. Van Dijk looks certain to score as the move unfolds brilliantly, with Salah delivering a superb ball that sends Kerkez charging in at close range. Safonov makes the initial stop, but the rebound falls invitingly for Van Dijk with the goal at his mercy. Out of nowhere, Marquinhos recovers in time and produces a remarkable intervention to deny what seemed an inevitable finish! Substitution at Liverpool Liverpool sub: A painful moment as Ekitike is carried off on a stretcher, clearly distraught as he leaves the pitch. The game quickly moves on, though, with Salah stepping into the action to a surge of anticipation around the ground. A hush falls as Ekitike remains grounded, visibly distressed and holding his lower leg after the challenge. Teammates and staff rush to his side and the concern is evident with the stoppage stretching on. Dembele whips in a superb ball from the right, picking out Doue lurking in a pocket of space at the far post. It's set up perfectly for a first-time finish, but he hesitates, taking an extra touch and losing control as the opportunity drifts away. Gravenberch drives forward with real authority, brushing past Vitinha before slipping a perfectly weighted pass into the path of Isak. The striker times his movement well at first glance and charges through on goal, only to be met by a brave block from Safonov rushing off his line. But the assistant's flag is already raised for offside. Twenty minutes played at Anfield and the deadlock remains, with neither side able to find the breakthrough. The atmosphere crackles with intensity as both teams battle for control, the game finely poised and goalless. Joao Neves surges into the area with real purpose and slips a delightful pass into the heart of the box, picking out Dembele just eight yards from goal. It looks like a certain chance, but the finish is rushed, hooked high and sailing over the crossbar when he really should be hitting the target! Gravenberch doesn't catch his volley cleanly, but the mishit loops dangerously towards goal, causing a moment of uncertainty. Under pressure, Safonov stays alert and reacts decisively, punching it clear to remove any danger. Frimpong sends a deep, searching delivery towards the far side where Kerkez arrives to collect, but his follow-up lacks conviction, a tame return played straight into the gloves of Safonov. Dembele sets things in motion with a sharp through ball for Neves, but Mamardashvili reads it early and races out to intervene, clearing upfield. The delivery drops invitingly into the area and Isak steals a yard on his marker, rising from around 12 yards with a clear sight of goal. It's a decent connection, but lacking the placement needed and Safonov stands firm to gather comfortably. Wirtz begins to pull the strings, gliding down the flank with intent before driving a sharp, low delivery into the danger area. It takes a telling deflection off a defender and spins out of play, handing Liverpool a corner as they start to build momentum. Zaire-Emery wastes no time making his presence felt, letting fly from distance with a measured effort from around 20 yards. The attempt has ambition, aiming to bend beyond reach, but Konate reacts sharply, rising well to glance it safely over the bar. Liverpool get us going in red and white from left to right, while Paris Saint-Germain are in black! Start of match PSG are unchanged as they look to reach the last four for the third consecutive season. Isak has scored just three times since his £125 million move from Newcastle in an injury-disrupted first season at Anfield, and only made his return from a broken leg as a substitute in the first leg. Mohamed Salah was left on the bench by Arne Slot for what could be the Egyptian's final Champions League game at Liverpool as Alexander Isak started for the first time since December against Paris Saint-Germain. Paris Saint-Germain starting XI: Safonov (GK); Hakimi, Marquinhos, Willian Pacho, Nuno Mendes; Zaire-Emery, Vitinha, Neves; Kvaratskhelia, Dembele and Doue. Liverpool starting XI: Mamardashvili (GK); Kerkez, Van Dijk, Konate, Frimpong; Mac Allister, Gravenberch, Szoboszlai; Florian Wirtz, Ekitike and Alexander Isak. Maurizio Mariani will take charge on the pitch for this one, with Marco Di Bello serving as the VAR. Paris Saint-Germain possible lineup: Safonov (GK); Hakimi, Marquinhos, Pacho, Mendes; Zaire-Emery, Vitinha, Neves; Doue, Dembele and Kvaratskhelia. Liverpool possible lineup: Mamardashvili (GK); Szoboszlai, Konate, Van Dijk, Kerkez; Gravenberch, Mac Allister; Salah, Wirtz, Ngumoha; Ekitike. Another embarrassment like the ones suffered recently in Manchester and Paris, but this time on home soil, could be the final straw for many fans. A 2-0 win over Fulham on Saturday gave Slot's men some breathing space from the chasing pack in the battle for Champions League football and also snapped a three-game losing streak. Six-time European champions Liverpool are still alive in the competition thanks to PSG's profligacy and they have overcome greater odds in the past under the lights at Anfield. Slot's side are on the brink of being eliminated by PSG for a second successive season after a disappointing display in Paris last week. Pre-match 14 April 2026, 21:00 Referee: Maurizio Mariani | VAR: Marco Di Bello Stadium: Anfield Hello everyone, and welcome to live coverage of the 2025/26 Champions League quarter-finals fixture between Liverpool and Paris Saint-Germain, kick-off at 21.00 CET, at Anfield in Merseyside, England!
